title: Polynomial threshold function count bound
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the number of Boolean functions on $n$ coordinates that admit a polynomial threshold representation of Fourier degree at most $k$ is at most $(2^n+1)^{|\mathcal{F}_{n,k}|}$, where $\mathcal{F}_{n,k}$ is the family of subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ of size at most $k$.
